claims.claim: The reviewer credits Le Guin with a gift for alliteration in short phrases.
claims.quote: gift for alliteration brings us beautiful little phrases

claims.claim: The reviewer says the book teaches its systems of trade and government along the way.
claims.quote: its systems of trade and government

claims.claim: The reviewer says Le Guin doles out world detail so skillfully that the narrative flow is never interrupted.
claims.quote: doles it out so skillfully that the flow of the narrative

claims.claim: A reviewer who reread A Wizard of Earthsea reports it feels all surface and no depth.
claims.source: The Book Nut blog (reviewer not named on the page), 30 March 2018
claims.quote: It just feels all surface and no depth

claims.claim: A commenter says the book has a lot of narrative that tells instead of showing.
claims.source: Reader comment on The Book Nut, 30 March 2018
claims.quote: It has a lot of narrative that tells instead of showing

claims.claim: The same commenter argues telling lets the reader use their imagination more.
claims.source: Reader comment on The Book Nut, 30 March 2018
claims.quote: It lets the reader use their imagination more

claims.claim: Another commenter praises the spare, beautiful prose and the mythic feel of the narrative.
claims.source: Reader comment on The Book Nut, 30 March 2018
claims.quote: the spare, beautiful prose and the inevitable, mythic feel

claims.claim: A reviewer says Tehanu centres the story not on the grand and powerful but on the small and ordinary.
claims.source: Wet Broken Things blog, "Book review - Tehanu", 25 May 2025
claims.quote: not on the grand and powerful, but the small, the powerless

claims.claim: The same reviewer lists the book's subject matter as the harvest, cooking and cleaning, and conversations amongst women.
claims.quote: the harvest, cooking and cleaning, conversations amongst women

claims.claim: A book blogger reports the Earthsea novels are neither long nor wordy.
claims.source: Moda od Radosti (Croatian book and fashion blog; reviewer not named on the page), review of Tehanu, August 2024
claims.quote: the novels in Earthsea Cycle are neither long nor wordy

claims.claim: The same blogger says the language is precise and descriptive.
claims.source: Moda od Radosti (reviewer not named on the page), August 2024
claims.quote: The language is precise and descriptive

claims.claim: The blogger says the natural laws and mythology of Earthsea are more hinted on than explained.
claims.source: Moda od Radosti (reviewer not named on the page), August 2024
claims.quote: is more hinted on than explained

claims.claim: The blogger concludes Le Guin proves worldbuilding can succeed without going into detail.
claims.source: Moda od Radosti (reviewer not named on the page), August 2024
claims.quote: you can do successful worldbuilding without going into detail

claims.claim: Michael Chabon lists the ingredients of the Earthsea world as its flora, its weather, and the dialects and ceremonies of its inhabitants.

claims.quote: from its flora to its weather to the dialects and ceremonies
